name: numera
description: Numera monorepo - natural-language text cross-platform calculator

scripts.dev: npm run build:wasm && npm run dev --workspace=web
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/wasm --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name numera_wasm --dev
scripts.build:wasm:release: wasm-pack build crates/wasm --target web --out-dir pkg --out-name numera_wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:wasm:release && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:web: npm run build:wasm:release && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && rm -rf node_modules crates/wasm/pkg
